question: At which coupling does a population of oscillators with spread natural frequencies synchronize, and what remains free in the synchronized state?

provenance.source: Y. Kuramoto, Lecture Notes in Physics 39, 420 (1975); E. Ott and T. M. Antonsen, Chaos 18, 037113 (2008)

name: population of phase oscillators (Kuramoto, Ott-Antonsen reduction)

carrier.name: complex order parameter z = x + i y = <exp(i theta)>

closure: infinitely many oscillators with a Lorentzian distribution of natural frequencies of half-width Delta, in the frame rotating with their mean; the fluctuations of a finite population enter as noise
observable: the order parameter r = |z| and the collective phase arg z
assumptions: the Ott-Antonsen manifold, exact for Lorentzian frequencies
the noise intensity is chosen for the example and stands for a finite population
